hypothesis: Within Solo/Duo patch16.2 map11, timestamped recognized ward activity through15min may be associated with team100 outcome conditional on gold, kills and tower captures observed by that horizon. Predictive, not causal.
thresholdInterpretation: Conservative operational gates fixed before any model evaluation, not universal power requirements. Recognized fraction counts registered ward events, not spatial visibility coverage. Changing gates requires a new protocol version.

modelPlanIfSupported.baseline: Regularized logistic regression on standardized goldDiff, killDiff, towerDiff; transformations learned in train only, fixed candidate regularization grid0.01/0.1/1/10 selected on chronological validation log loss.
modelPlanIfSupported.augmented: Same procedure plus recognizedPlacementDiff, recognizedRemovalDiff, controlPlacementDiff. Unknown types are audited separately; literal MET19 counts never renamed recognized wards.
modelPlanIfSupported.evaluation: Locked temporal test: log loss, Brier, ROC AUC, calibration intercept/slope and fixed probability-bin reliability with counts; compare baseline and augmented on identical match IDs. Paired match bootstrap intervals, disclose recurring-player dependence and player-disjoint sensitivity. No coefficient or AUC is produced in the present study.
modelPlanIfSupported.stability: Repeat all prespecified horizons/windows and report every result; do not select best test horizon. Patch16.2 only: cross-patch stability cannot be assessed here. A future multi-patch protocol must separate or hold out patches.
modelPlanIfSupported.contextLimits: Roster champions are in raw source but not used in this small study; role inferred from final summary and discovery-time rank are not known-at15. Baseline is limited context, not full confounder adjustment. No individual participant rows as independent outcomes.
